thread:
Maya Chen: Candidate (Rohit) just confirmed he can make it but needs a short accessibility desk (standing option) and his Mac charger. ETA 10:40, original schedule 09:30. Can we rearrange morning panels?
Omar Rahim: I can swap with my 11:30 slot. Priya, can you take the 10:45 panel instead of 09:30?
Priya Desai: I can move, but I'll need the panel shortened to 35m. Also please make sure the Mac charger and a USB-C adapter are available.
Maya Chen: Great. Carlos, can you book standing desk in Quiet Room A and grab a USB-C + MagSafe adapter? Also need NDA on arrival (paper) & wifi creds on sticky.
Carlos Mendez: On it 4cc Quiet Room A reserved 10:30-13:00. I'll leave MagSafe+USB-C adapters and charger in a labeled pouch. NDA printed and in envelope.
Reception Bot: Note: All guests require photo ID and to sign NDA. Badge printing will be ~2 min on check-in.
Recruiter Bot: Rohit requested vegetarian + gluten-free lunch. Logged in candidate profile.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Also need short parking permit and directions for public transit (candidate might take BART). Javier please? (cc @Carlos)
Carlos Mendez: I added transit note with nearest BART line and short walking map to calendar invite. Parking pass queued P2 if he drives.
Omar Rahim: Calendar updated: moved panels to 10:45 start, 35m each, 10m buffer. Invites sent with updated Zoom fallback link in case of delay.
Priya Desai: Can interviewers get a one-page resume in their invite? I don't have Rohit's latest.
Recruiter Bot: Resume uploaded to candidate profile. Sending to all panelists now.
Maya Chen: Also: please enable guest VLAN (Redwood-Guest) and local VPN token pre-provisioned for take-home environment for 30m. Ben in infra can you do that? @Ben Torres
Ben Torres: Will pre-provision a 30m VPN token and whitelist candidate MAC for the laptop pool. Laptop pool note: we have a MacBook loaner available in Locker 3.
Carlos Mendez: I'll fetch the MacBook from Locker 3 and drop it in Quiet Room A by 10:10 with charger & adapters. Sticky note on laptop: "WiFi: Redwood-Guest / PW: visit1234"
Priya Desai: Quick heads up: Alex might need to join remotely for the last panel at 12:00. We should prepare to switch one panel to remote if needed.
Maya Chen: Noted. Keep the remote fallback link pinned in the room calendar and have an HDMI cable ready in case we need to mirror.
Reception Bot: Reminder: Please confirm arrival 20 minutes before candidate check-in to speed badge printing.
Maya Chen: I've messaged Rohit with revised start 10:45, provided BART/parking options, and confirmed dietary + accessory needs. He replied: "10:45 works, thanks — will bring ID."
Omar Rahim: Everything set from my side. If the candidate prefers remote last-minute, we can keep momentum.
Carlos Mendez: Quiet Room A set, MacBook in place at 10:05, NDA + lunch notes posted. Parking P2 QR sent to Maya DM.
Priya Desai: Resume received, calendar updated, panels shortened. See you all.
Maya Chen: Thanks team 44d closing thread.
